description.en: Verb-function concept for expressing an action or process in progress at a reference moment, structured in the Master through TO BE + verb-ING.
description.es: Concepto de función verbal para expresar una acción o proceso en desarrollo en un momento de referencia, estructurado en la Master mediante TO BE + verbo-ING.
description.pt: Conceito de função verbal para expressar uma ação ou processo em andamento em um momento de referência, estruturado na Master por TO BE + verbo-ING.

metadata.notes: v0.1 treats Movement as a distinct verb-function concept centered on an action or process in progress, structured through TO BE + verb-ING. Spatial displacement and direction may appear as applications, but they do not define the concept. Boundaries remain intentionally permeable with prepositions, timelines, sentence structure, questions and practical communication.
